in_marathi.name: Dhanuja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanuja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhanuja is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhanus’, which means ‘bow’. The name is believed to bestow prosperity and wealth upon the bearer. In Hindu mythology, Dhanuja is also the name of a king who ruled over the kingdom of Magadha and was known for his valor and wisdom.
